body: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a NEW original Aster 170 2003 three-door sporting hatchback, 2994 salvage racing-game body sprite sheet. Reference ONLY worn handpainted material, eight-view layout and real transparent wheel openings, NOT its tall five-door shape. Change design to LOW WIDE athletic compact three-door hatch with one long door per side, short hood, sharply raked windshield, triangular rear quarter windows, angled hatch, small roof spoiler, broad shoulders. Dark aubergine paint and faded ivory replacement front fenders, moss-green repair patches. Original angular headlights, narrow diagonal rear lamps, no logos/badges/text and not an exact real manufacturer design. Eight isolated views in4columns x2rows, wide3:1 canvas: top front, frontquarter noseRIGHT, fullside noseLEFT, rearquarter noseLEFT; bottom rear, rearquarter noseRIGHT, fullside noseRIGHT, frontquarter noseLEFT. Same body in all views. Exactly one door handle each side (three-door hatch, NOT five-door). NO tires, rims or wheels: all arches fully transparent cutouts open to bottom, no opaque black backing/suspension. Runtime draws tires. Fixed low game camera, no ground/shadows/scenery. Clean real transparent background and margins, no clipping, no overlapping sprites.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original Aster1702003 compact hot-hatch LHD dashboard game overlay in worn painterly2994 salvage style. Reference ONLY material style and transparent overlay structure. Wide2.5:1 canvas. Angular charcoal dashboard, faded ivory inset fascia and plum/moss repair patches, two trapezoid central vents, simple small tactile center controls, angular passenger glovebox. Huge completely BLANK opaque black LEFT driver binnacle x210..790,y440..680 in1983x793 canvas, no painted gauges/numbers/dials, runtime draws instruments. NO steering wheel, steering column, hands, logos, lettering or scenery. Genuine transparent windshield region above dashboard; thin A-pillars at extreme edges only, no roof along top. Straight-on driver view, dash occupying lower half, clean transparent silhouette. Original fictional dashboard, not exact manufacturer replica.
